subject: general
question: The age of a mother is three times the age of her daughter. After 12 years, the mother's age will be twice the daughter's age. Find the present age of the mother.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Present Ratio (Mother : Daughter) = 3 : 1 (Difference = 2 units)

Ratio after 12 years = 2 : 1 (Difference = 1 unit)

Equate differences: Multiply future ratio by 2 → 4 : 2

Ratio change: 3 to 4 (Mother) or 1 to 2 (Daughter) = 1 unit

1 unit = 12 years

Mother's present age = 3 units = 3 × 12 = 36 years

**∴ The correct answer is 36 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Mother's age = 3 × Daughter's age

After 12 years, Mother's age = 2 × Daughter's age

**Formula Used:**

Linear equations in one variable: Age after n years = Present Age + n

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/937cbaf4dca84de5308ece6157425c9ed717dc68c379d6b1ede6e9c95821ab9f.png] 

Let the present age of the daughter be x years.

⇒ Mother's present age = 3x

⇒ After 12 years, Mother's age = 3x + 12

⇒ After 12 years, Daughter's age = x + 12

⇒ 3x + 12 = 2 × (x + 12)

⇒ 3x + 12 = 2x + 24

⇒ 3x − 2x = 24 − 12

⇒ x = 12

⇒ Mother's present age = 3 × 12 = 36 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 36 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Constant Age Difference

The difference between the ages of two individuals remains constant regardless of the number of years that pass.

Ratio Balancing Method

When ages at two different times are given as ratios, scaling the ratios to have the same part-difference allows for solving without algebra.

Average Age Property

If the current average age of a group is A, then after 'n' years, the new average age will be A + n.
